changes.text: Tempo: logging time from an own event deletes it (a one-off event, or just this occurrence of a series) instead of marking it done
UI: a plain hyphen instead of the em dash in tooltips, labels, window titles, messages and settings texts
Tempo: the worklog form opened from the shown window (day scale, an event's menu) keeps the view and returns to it
My events: finished events go above the rest and show only when scrolling up, the screen opens on the first not finished one
Events list: past own events show only when scrolling up, the scroll position is kept relative to "now"
Day scale: drag on an empty place to select an interval for a new own event
Day scale: grid step from the right-click menu on an empty place, the step sets the scale; zooming in keeps the view in place
Storage: daily cleanup of the local database — marks of deleted events, done marks older than a year, seen marks of gone Jenkins jobs; optimize, WAL truncate, VACUUM
Exchange: a task change with a stale change key is retried with the current key
Exchange: a flagged task found in both the Tasks and To-Do folders is listed once
